scope: crypto / Binance Spot / long-only, marketable (taker) orders; interfaces generic (Execution Adapter -> Canonical Execution Schema)

terms.definition: T: the instant a (hypothetical) strategy decides. Only market state with available_at_ms <= T is decision information.

The market reference at decision time: the PIT book state at T (bid, ask and mid). It is a reference, NOT automatically executable; nothing is ever filled at it unless a model declares so (none in v1).
T + declared_latency_ms (latency model). The fill model uses only market state with available_at_ms <= execution_time.
(bid + ask) / 2 of one book state. Analytical only: never an execution price; the basis of the bps cost decomposition.
The executable top-of-book reference at execution time: a buy executes against the ASK, a sell against the BID (marketable, taker).
ask - bid of one book state, in price units.
(ask - bid) / mid * 1e4.
Cost of crossing from mid to the touch: side * (touch - mid) / mid * 1e4 (the half-spread, side = +1 buy, -1 sell).

The modeled execution price: touch * (1 + side * s), s = slippage fraction of the slippage model. Never silently equal to the decision price; equal to the touch only when the slippage model declares s = 0 (X0-S0).

Adverse price difference BEYOND the executable reference (touch) at execution time: side * (fill - touch) / touch * 1e4. Distinct from market movement (latency_drift_bps), spread (spread_cost_bps), fees (fee_bps) and adverse selection.
Market movement between decision and execution: side * (mid_exec - mid_decision) / mid_decision * 1e4. A market movement, NOT a cost component and NOT slippage.
Explicit exchange fee rate on executed notional, from the versioned fee schedule (bps). Charged on fill notional; never folded into a price.
Second-order cross terms so that the decomposition is exact: total_cost_bps - spread_cost_bps - slippage_bps - fee_bps.
side * (effective_price - mid) / mid * 1e4 with effective_price = fill * (1 + side * fee); equals spread_cost_bps + slippage_bps + fee_bps + interaction_bps exactly.
Round trip only: mid_exit_exec / mid_entry_exec - 1 (cost-free market movement between the two execution times).

Round trip only: effective_exit / effective_entry - 1 with effective_entry = fill_entry * (1 + fee_entry) and effective_exit = fill_exit * (1 - fee_exit). Includes spread, slippage and fees; never a silent zero.
Post-entry price movement against the position (a future research LABEL, separate from slippage). Not computed in X0: always UNAVAILABLE with reason.
Price response caused by the order itself. Refused in X0 (no trade prints, no queue, no hidden liquidity, sampled depth): always UNAVAILABLE with reason.
execution_time - observed_at_ms of the PIT-selected record (time since the collector received that quote).
t - the latest persisted sample boundary (sample_ms <= t) of the stream: how long since the collector last confirmed the stream state.

provenance_classes.definition: A recorded observation used as-is (book bid/ask/quantities, depth levels, timestamps).
Exact arithmetic of MEASURED values (mid, spread, spread cost, ages).
A model approximation of an unobserved quantity from MEASURED inputs (displayed-depth walk slippage).
A declared research assumption, not observed (fee schedule, fixed stress slippage, zero slippage, latency).
Not computable from the data or not modeled; value is null with a reason, never zero.

propagation: a composite takes the weakest (highest rank) provenance of its components; any UNAVAILABLE component makes the composite UNAVAILABLE (null + reason). ASSUMED is never presented as MEASURED.
